fields.quoted_span: an owner of residential real property shall not, over the course of any 12-month period, increase the gross rental rate for a dwelling or a unit more than 5 percent plus the percentage change in the cost of living, or 10 percent, whichever is lower, of the lowest gross rental rate charged for that dwelling or unit at any time during the 12 months prior to the effective date of the increase.
fields.note: All components check against the statute: exclusion of accepted discounts, two increments, initial rent for new tenancy, § 827 notice, sublease limit, waiver void, remedies, treble damages, 3-year limit, and AG/city attorney/county counsel enforcement.

fields.quoted_span: This section shall remain in effect until January 1, 2030, and as of that date is repealed.
fields.note: Cap formula, two increments, overcharge damages, treble damages for willful violations, 3-year limit and repeal date are all in the text. The cap is 'lower of 5% + CPI or 10%', as stated.

fields.quoted_span: (n) This section shall become operative on April 1, 2024.
fields.note: Operative April 1, 2024; effective Jan. 1, 2024 per the history note. The effective_date_note is accurate on the March 15, 2019 and Feb. 18, 2021 application dates and the 2030 repeal.

fields.quoted_span: This section shall become operative on April 1, 2024.
fields.note: Operative since April 1, 2024 and in effect until Jan. 1, 2030, so 'in_force' is consistent with the text. The document does not state the current date.

fields.quoted_span: Housing that has been issued a certificate of occupancy within the previous 15 years, unless the housing is a mobilehome.
fields.note: Summary, exemptions, owner conditions, mobilehome-homeowner exclusion, local rent control exemption and owner-occupied duplex are all grounded in subds. (d), (g)(4), (j) and (m). Statewide scope with a stricter-local-control exemption is accurate.

The document supports Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.12, Stats. 2023, ch. 290 and SB 567. The aliases AB 1482 and 'Tenant Protection Act of 2019' do not appear in the document. 'Chapter 2 (Hiring of Real Property)' appears in the heading.
